notes_for_editor: Thin record. The only sources are the NHLR detail page, the July 2020 state public-lands list, and the county wildfire plan, which mentions the E911 and cell towers but no fire lookout. The brief lists status standing; I have set it to unknown because no visit or condition report was found, though the register describes it in the present tense. No build date is given. A search result named a Forestry Commission-registered structure in Brookhaven (170.6 ft, built 1994) on towerdex; it is an antenna registry entry, not checked, and not used. Search snippets about other Lincoln County towers were not used.
